name: Living alone for the first time, you realise 90% of life is

lines.ref:
Living alone for the first time,
you realise 90% of life is
just cooking or cleaning...

shots.brief: cleaning or dusting ceiling / high shelf at home (ref: Young man using an extended duster to clean a ceiling fan in the living room.; tripod)
making bed or lint-rolling furniture (ref: Man rolling a lint roller across a large bolster pillow on a bed.; tripod)
cooking food in kitchen pot (ref: Close-up of man dropping dumplings into a pot of boiling water on the stove.; tripod)
vacuuming or sweeping apartment floor (ref: Man vacuuming the hallway floor with a stick vacuum.; tripod)
washing dishes or wiping down kitchen counter (ref: Man washing a wooden cutting board in the kitchen sink.; tripod)

audit.notes: Easily recreated with any ~1-second clips of mundane household maintenance, cooking, wiping surfaces, doing laundry, or dishwashing from the creator's apartment routine footage.
audit.summary: A montage of quick 1-second cuts showing everyday solo apartment chores (dusting, lint-rolling bedding, boiling dumplings, vacuuming, washing dishes) accompanied by a relatable text hook about adulthood.
